description: Frozen run-of-record files of the DualScope final detection model. Never retrained.
git_revision_note: Revision recorded in gru/run_manifest.json (source_revision) and fusion/manifest.json (git_revision); both runs used it.

gru/checkpoint.pt.description: GRU autoencoder weights (run A, sequence length 32, hidden 32); produces the max_event score

gru/run_manifest.json.description: GRU training record with the sequence configuration used to build the model

fusion/model.joblib.description: Frozen HistGradientBoosting fusion model (GRU max_event plus hourly counts)

fusion/manifest.json.description: Fusion model record: inputs, settings, hash and the GRU run it expects

features/preprocessing.json.description: Frozen feature preprocessing fitted on the training days; any feature build must use this file
